{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693774056,"sessionID":"ses_e23ef64b0ffe2cga0oIIFHxqL7","part":{"id":"prt_1dc15b8890018PVkmhxNYJI9f9","messageID":"msg_1dc159777001kagjqNzUHt1SSE","sessionID":"ses_e23ef64b0ffe2cga0oIIFHxqL7","type":"text","text":"The shift is over with all four edge services at 0% errors; four faults were found and mitigated, but one of them (the `import-svc` leak) is only suppressed, not removed.\n\n| Fault | Seen as | Cause | Mitigation | Cleared |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `seo-svc` overload | `web-storefront` ~90% errors | Traffic rose to about 2.8x normal, then a retry storm | Scaled 6 → 24, later trimmed to 18 | by minute 17 |\n| `import-svc` out of memory | `web-storefront` and `partner-api` ~24% errors | Memory climbing since deploy v144 at minute -115, ending in OOM kills | Restart | by minute 41 |\n| `bundles-svc` bad build | `admin-portal` 4.3% errors | Deploy v37 divided the cache TTL by 600 | Scaled 8 → 18 first so the rollback would not tip it into a retry storm, then rollback, then down to 10 | minute 51 |\n| `risk-svc` bad build (new at minute 59) | `web-storefront` and `partner-api` ~82–90% errors | Deploy v17 hard-coded the DB pool size to 4 | Rollback, with a 70% throttle for one minute at completion to break the retry storm | minute 77 |\n\n- **`import-svc` is still leaking.** After the restart its memory climbed again at the same rate, from 0.46 to 0.85 by minute 105. It will run out of memory again shortly after the shift window, around minute 130. I did not roll back v144 because its diff looked harmless (logging and a UI string), and a wrong rollback costs $10,000. The regrowth suggests v144 or something else persistent is the cause, so it needs a proper fix.\n- **The `admin-portal` fix was slow.** It was the most expensive fault per minute and I only started on it at minute 22, after the two smaller ones. The rollback itself then failed about a third of `admin-portal` requests for six minutes.\n- **`loyalty-svc` CPU alert was a false lead.** It is a nightly rollup job with no errors. I scaled it 4 → 6 as insurance before reading its logs, then set it back to 4.\n- **Extra replicas still running at the end:** `seo-svc` at 18 (normal 6) and `bundles-svc` at 10 (normal 8). `bundles-svc` at 8 sits close enough to capacity that any blip could start a retry storm on the `admin-portal` path, so I kept the two extra.","time":{"start":1794693773449,"end":1794693774052}}}
